title: MMWR Articles | Overdose Prevention | CDC
content: MMWR Articles Aug. 29, 2025 Key points The MMWR overdose series provides reports on recent and historical overdose related topics like illegal and prescription opioids (e.g., fentanyl, heroin), polysubstance use, psychostimulants, benzodiazepines, xylazine, naloxone, and cannabis. These articles include the latest overdose related scientific information from CDC, as well as historical publications on nonfatal and fatal overdoses, substance use related harms, and substance use disorder. Articles MMWR Overdose Topics Reports See the MMWR reports to search the latest by our topic areas such as: opioids (prescription and illegal), fentanyl, acute/chronic pain and pain management, psychostimulants, polysubstance use, drug overdose, benzodiazepines, substance use disorders (e.g. opioid use disorder), and naloxone. It includes weekly reports, surveillance summaries, and supplements on cross-cutting topics from across CDC. 2025 Tanz LJ, Miller KD, Dinwiddie AT, et al.
